Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [018_31_preliminary_analyses] CR correlated with an increased negative afect and decreased life satisfaction at T1 and T2, respectively. Resilience was signifcantly related to all three indices of SWB at both T1 and T2. The three indices of SWB were stable for a moderate correlation in the two waves (r=0.31–0.44). Furthermore, life satisfaction exhibited a positive correlation with positive afect and a negative correlation with negative afect at both T1 and T2.
